# Statement of Work No. 7

This Statement of Work ("SOW") is entered into under the Master Services Agreement dated 14 March 2025 between **Quillmark Studio Ltd** ("Supplier") and **Halvorsen Freight AS** ("Client"). Terms not defined here have the meaning given in the MSA.

## 1. Services
Supplier will design and produce a brand refresh for Client's customer-facing tracking portal, including a visual identity guide, a component library and up to 12 page templates.

## 2. Deliverables and milestones
| # | Deliverable | Due |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Discovery findings and moodboards | 30 Oct 2026 |
| 2 | Visual identity guide | 27 Nov 2026 |
| 3 | Component library + templates | 22 Jan 2027 |

## 3. Fees and payment
Fixed fee of EUR 64,000. Supplier will invoice 30% on signature, 30% on acceptance of Deliverable 2 and 40% on acceptance of Deliverable 3. Invoices are payable within 30 days.

## 4. Acceptance
Client has 10 business days to accept or reject each deliverable in writing. Silence is deemed acceptance.

## 5. Term
This SOW ends on acceptance of the final deliverable or 28 February 2027, whichever comes first.
